items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Terminology 55:1
items.html: The place of pregnancy is in the lower third of the Tifferet of AVI, at the time when they are a single Partzuf with YESHSUT. At the time of their division, the Rosh [head] of YESHSUT is found there, so that the Peh [mouth] of the Rosh of YESHSUT is almost the opening of the Yesod of Abba and Ima as a whole, meaning at the time when they became a single Partzuf. See answer 13. (Page 884, Item 36).
